title: LLM Settings
description: Per-project ladder/retry/self-heal/cost-control settings for orchestrations/scripts/claude.sh, loaded from EPAM_PROJECT_CONFIG_DIR/llm-settings.json by load_llm_settings_json(). Every field is a FALLBACK DEFAULT ONLY — an already-exported EPAM_* env var (from the launch shell or a project .env file) always wins; see claude.sh's load_llm_settings_json() docstring.

temperatureFloor.description: EPAM_TEMPERATURE — the project-wide base temperature every story starts at (rung 0), restored after any mid-story override. Shared by both ladders; there is only one floor per project.

rungs.description: The 4-rung escalation structure (0-3), matching claude.sh's fixed retry_count/2 case statement. This structure is SHARED by both the high and medium ladders — only the model each rung resolves to differs (see ladders.*.modelLadder). Rung 0 is the initial attempt; rungs 1-3 are entered every 2 retries.

reasoningEffort.description: Wired: read by load_llm_settings_json() into EPAM_RUNG{0,1,2,3}_REASONING_EFFORT, applied in the rung case statement.

temperature.description: Wired (rungs 1-3 only, via EPAM_RUNG{1,2,3}_TEMPERATURE). null = no rung-level override; inherits temperatureFloor.

iterationBump.description: NOT WIRED — documentation of current behavior only. The real iteration bump on entering a rung is computed dynamically by _brownfield_rung_bump() (10% of CPA's iterationEstimate, floored at 5), not read from this field. Editing this value has no effect; it exists so the grid can be read as a whole without cross-referencing claude.sh.

outputTokenBump.description: NOT WIRED — documentation of current behavior only, hardcoded in the rung case statement (8192/12288) and applied only if it exceeds the story's current ceiling, which in brownfield mode is already the brownfield.minOutputTokens floor — see that field's own note about this making the bump inert at its current default. Editing this value has no effect.

ladders.description: The only thing that differs between ladder tiers: which models each rung actually resolves to (via the shared rungs[] structure above).

modelOverrides.description: Keyed by an arbitrary label (e.g. "minimax-m2.5", "kimi", "glm-5.2") — the key is just a lookup name; matching happens purely via matchOn/matchValue|matchSubstring against the FINAL resolved STORY_PROVIDER/STORY_MODEL for that attempt (a story that escalated away from a match correctly does not receive it). Any number of entries is allowed, so distinct model tiers sharing one provider (MiniMax-M2.5 vs MiniMax-M3) can carry different budgets. Checked in object key order in claude.sh's resolver; the FIRST entry that matches wins. Applied AFTER the rung's own effort/temperature default — unconditionally replaces it, by design, rather than merely filling a gap.

maxRetries.description: EPAM_MAX_RETRIES. Total ladder-driven retries before self-heal extension is considered.

extensionMax.description: EPAM_RETRY_EXTENSION_MAX — additional attempts granted beyond maxRetries when self-heal analysis judges the story recoverable.

storyTimeoutSecs.description: EPAM_STORY_TIMEOUT_SECS — wall-clock kill per story attempt. Wraps BOTH the plan pass (tool-free, capped separately at EPAM_PLAN_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 90) and the implementation pass — a deadline sized for the implementation pass alone would kill agents that used to finish comfortably, so this value should generally exceed EPAM_PLAN_TIMEOUT_SECS by that much headroom. Also read by run-agent-orchestration.sh's run_story_with_watchdog() as a flat override (skips storyEffortTimeoutSecs scaling below) — loaded there by _load_timeout_config() (lib/story-guards.sh), NOT by claude.sh's load_llm_settings_json(), since claude.sh runs too late (as a subprocess of run_story_with_watchdog itself) to influence its own wrapping timeout.

gateTimeoutSecs.description: EPAM_GATE_TIMEOUT_SECS — wall-clock kill per QA testing-gate invocation.

storyEffortTimeoutSecs.description: Per-effort-tier base timeout (seconds), read by run-agent-orchestration.sh's run_story_with_watchdog() before scaling by roleTimeoutMultipliers. Replaces the previously-hardcoded case statement (low=600/medium=1200/high=2400/default=900) with a configurable, project-tunable one — no project-specific fact should be baked into pipeline code. Any tier left unset keeps its hardcoded default.

default.description: EPAM_STORY_EFFORT_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_SECS — used when a story's effort field is missing/unrecognized. Default when unset: 900.

roleTimeoutMultipliers.description: Per-agentRole multiplier applied to the effort-tier base timeout, keyed by whatever agentRole value the pipeline itself assigned in prd.json (Step 0.5/0.9) — never a hardcoded role name. Serialized 1:1 into EPAM_ROLE_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER_MAP's 'role=mult|role2=mult2' string (the format resolve_role_timeout_multiplier() already parses). An unlisted role gets multiplier 1.0. Default when unset: {"test-engineer": 1.5}, matching the prior hardcoded default.

watchdogRetryMultiplier.description: EPAM_WATCHDOG_RETRY_MULTIPLIER — scales the timeout on a retry after a story timed out once (rationale: a story that already burned self-heal attempts within one budget has a larger cumulative prompt on retry, so the same flat budget that already proved insufficient is the wrong one to hand it again). Default when unset: 1.5. Set to 1 to restore flat-timeout-on-retry behavior.

minOutputTokens.description: EPAM_BROWNFIELD_MIN_OUTPUT_TOKENS — output-token floor applied to every brownfield story regardless of effort tier. NOTE: at its current default (24576) this floor already exceeds every rung's own outputTokenBump, making those bumps inert — see the current-vs-best-practice report.

maxScaledIterations.description: EPAM_BROWNFIELD_MAX_SCALED_ITERATIONS — ceiling on CPA's iterationEstimate-scaled iteration floor.

defaultAutoCompressAt.description: EPAM_AUTO_COMPRESS_AT — token-count compaction trigger, used when the resolved model has no modelOverrides entry of its own.

defaultAutoCompressEveryNIterations.description: EPAM_AUTO_COMPRESS_EVERY_N_ITERATIONS — iteration-count compaction trigger; null disables it, leaving only the token trigger.

maxToolCallsPerStory.description: EPAM_MAX_TOOL_CALLS for the main story implementer invocation. null = unlimited. This IS set per project — see orchestrations/projects/*/llm-settings.json — and is wired at claude.sh:248 into EPAM_STORY_MAX_TOOL_CALLS, which the writer invocation passes as EPAM_MAX_TOOL_CALLS. Check the project file for the live value; an earlier version of this description asserted the cap was unused, which was read as 'the writer is uncapped' and reported as such on 2026-08-09 while a 300 cap was in force.

storyBudgetWarningUsd.description: Logged as a warning once a single story's cumulative real cost (summed from phase-cost.jsonl across all its retry/ladder attempts) crosses this. null = no warning. Advisory only — does not halt the story.

storyBudgetHardLimitUsd.description: Enforced (added 2026-08-01): once a story's cumulative real cost across all its retry/ladder attempts (summed from phase-cost.jsonl) reaches this, no further retries are granted — including skipping the self-heal retry-extension coordinator, so a budget stop cannot be overridden into more spend. The attempt already in flight when the threshold is crossed is allowed to finish normally (its cost was already committed); only the NEXT retry is blocked. null = no hard limit (current default — unlimited spend per story, bounded only by EPAM_MAX_RETRIES and EPAM_STORY_TIMEOUT_SECS).

matchOn.description: "provider" matches the exact resolved STORY_PROVIDER against matchValue (e.g. all minimax-routed calls). "model" matches STORY_MODEL by substring against matchSubstring (needed for models like kimi/glm that share one provider with others).

matchValue.description: Exact STORY_PROVIDER to match. Required (and only used) when matchOn is "provider".

matchSubstring.description: Substring tested against STORY_MODEL via a plain string contains(), not a glob/regex. Required (and only used) when matchOn is "model".

reasoningEffort.description: Sent as EPAM_REASONING_EFFORT. "low"/"medium"/"high" are real OpenRouter reasoning.effort values for GLM/Kimi; "adaptive"/"enabled"/"disabled" are MiniMax's documented `thinking` values, NOT `reasoning_effort` — MiniMaxProvider.ts currently sends whatever string is set here as `reasoning_effort` verbatim, which vendor docs suggest MiniMax's endpoint does not act on. See the current-vs-best-practice report; this is a known, unfixed transport-layer gap, not a schema constraint to enforce here.

temperature.description: Sent as EPAM_TEMPERATURE. NOTE: per Moonshot's own docs, OpenRouter fixes temperature/top_p server-side for Kimi K3 — a temperature set here for a kimi-matched entry is sent but likely has no effect through that route.

modelLadder.description: Ordered current=>next model transitions, mirrored 1:1 into EPAM_MODEL_LADDER_HIGH/MEDIUM's 'cur=next|cur2=next2' string. A model with no 'from' entry here has no escalation path — it is the ladder's ceiling.
